steps.content: The soldiers make short work of the abomination, but there is no relief in their victory. The thing quickly ceases to twitch, leaving only the heavy stench of blood.
Its form is more grotesque than any of them could have imagined. Once the corpse is laid out, the soldiers fall silent. They form a loose circle around it, unsure whether to step back or move closer.

steps.speaker: Iron Mask
steps.content: This isn't one of the Corruptors of the WhiteSands. What exactly is this thing...?
A deteriorated Sinner.
[Unsteady footsteps]
A man in gray staggers out from the warship. His face is pale, his steps unsteady. He can barely stand without help.
steps.female_content: A woman in gray staggers out from the warship. Her face is pale, her steps unsteady. She can barely stand without help.

steps.content: It's the Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control. Contamination from BR-005 is eating away at his body through the shackles, but the man overpowers the corruption with his will.
steps.female_content: It's the Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control. Contamination from BR-005 is eating away at her body through the shackles, but the woman overpowers the corruption with her will.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: What are you doing out here? The sand, the contamination... your body can't take it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's nothing. There's work to be done. You said it yourself, you need my experience to assess the contamination.
Fighting the pain from the Mania, you crouch down to inspect the bizarre corpse.

Parts of the creature's skin have crystallized, forming a broken, warped texture. The face is beginning to collapse. You stare at the twisted features, not quite human, not quite beast, your brow furrowed.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Not a sand beast, nor an Apostle of Ashes...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The M-value is too high. Never received any protection. They overused their abilities, and became completely deteriorated.
You search through the mangled remains. They're still wearing human clothes. You reach into the pockets and find something.
[Insert story item: Euphoria crest]
You pull out a metal object shaped like a ship's anchor, with a black serpent coiled around it.
It's the crest of a ship.
Everything clicks into place.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...They were abandoned here on purpose. Even after they became a Corruptor, they were provoked into attacking people who came close.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Someone is using them. Forcing the dead to stand guard, keeping anyone from entering this area.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Looks like that mysterious cruise ship is nearby.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...This is Farland's foothold in DisCity, the place where they make connections, trade intel, and engage in dirty deals. They're even using Mania to protect themselves, exploiting Sinners like this...
You finally let go of the corpse's hand and struggle to your feet. The doctor reaches out to steady you, but you decline her help.
You stand on your own, your gaze sweeping over the faces around you. When you speak, your voice is low but firm.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If they've learned how to create Sinners, this will be dangerous. We're in for a fight. The good news is, an encounter like this means we're close to their base. The bad news...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The enemy is on high alert. If we tip our hand, they might relocate at once.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My job is to handle hostile Sinners. I may not be able to fight alongside you, but I have the experience you need. That's why your leader asked for me, isn't it?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then let's not hesitate. We move now, and bring down every one of those bastards.
The doctor raises an eyebrow and gives you a cryptic smile.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: ...Understood. Though I do hope you follow doctor's orders during the operation, Chief. We can't let our esteemed consultant come to any harm, can we?
Euphoria, Mr. E's Office

The room is dimly lit. On the projection screen, an unfamiliar warship is crossing the WhiteSands, stark and militaristic. In the bottom corner, a real-time monitoring window flashes with a silent update: "Units lost: +6."

Mr. E sits calmly in his office chair, slowly turning the ring on his finger. His gaze is fixed on the approaching ship, his expression impassive. He speaks into the comms, his tone casual as he arranges his next moves.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Turn on the sandstorm generators. Give our guests a proper welcome.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: And get ready to evacuate. No, there aren't many. As for the others... I'll make arrangements.
He ends the call and goes over his prized assets one last time.

Recordings? Videos? Proof of transactions? No, of course not. He respects his guests' privacy. They are absolutely secure while indulging in their pleasures. Anyone who threatens Euphoria must vanish from this world... as is the case now.

What he needs is simpler: a passenger manifest. For every voyage, he ferries his guests across the WhiteSands to this secret paradise in the most exclusive, most discreet of private vessels. The boarding records and travel documentation for every guest are securely in his possession. That is enough.
Once they leave, every name on that list will become their "associate." Their fates will be his to command... and to offer up to those who are truly worthy.
The man turns coolly to face a mysterious silhouette in the shadows.

steps.speaker: Frail Voice
steps.content: I hear that person is coming. Won't that be a problem?

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: They're moving faster than I expected. But judging from their course, they're still some distance away. Our cover is sufficient, and the traps have been laid. That should buy us plenty of time.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: I've notified the guests to evacuate. All intelligence has been secured. Anything we can't take will be destroyed.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: As for Eastside... the Sillage Society will take care of things. Nothing will be leaked. Rest assured.

steps.speaker: Frail Voice
steps.content: Hehe. You misunderstand me. I'm just worried for that poor dear's frail body. If he were to die out here... his sister would be heartbroken.
steps.female_content: Hehe. You misunderstand me. I'm just worried for that poor dear's frail body. If she were to die out here... her sister would be heartbroken.

steps.speaker: Frail Voice
steps.content: I have complete faith in you, of course. This place has never been my concern. You have a leash on every guest. They obey your every word. You've always been so wonderfully thorough. I've never cared for the details.

steps.speaker: Frail Voice
steps.content: But when you said nothing would be leaked... you're not just talking about the guests, are you?
Mr. E smiles.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: My employees will be just as discreet, of course. Their fate was sealed the moment they stepped on board.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: They will take the secrets to their graves. Rest assured.
The room falls silent. Only a faint fragrance coils through the air, emanating from the frail figure. It carries the scent of death.

steps.speaker: Frail Voice
steps.content: I thought you were fond of those little toys of yours. You picked them so carefully, comforted them so gently... only to cast them aside so casually. You're such a cruel, cold-blooded man.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: You flatter me, ma'am. As your servant, it is my duty to meet your expectations. However, if you find it a waste, I've made arrangements...

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: For Euphoria's final performance, I've prepared a grand finale. Your favorite kind.
She finally laughs. A woman materializes, half-hidden by the violet smoke.

steps.speaker: Frail Voice
steps.content: In that case, I do hope I get to choose my favorite lead. May I?

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Of course. Anything to please you, My Lady.
What a dreadful title. The woman waves a dismissive hand.

steps.speaker: Frail Voice
steps.content: Call me <color=#fb9259>Evelleon</color>.
